We need to propose a retrosynthesis route with at least 3 reactions using templates 1914393, 1914394, 1914395 in this order.

We applied 1914393 to target SMILES, got a tuple of precursors: ('COc1cccc(NC(=O)c2nn[nH]c2N)c1', 'FC1CN(Cc2ccc(CCl)cc2)C1'). So first reaction splits target into two fragments: fragment A (aryl with methoxy and amide) and fragment B (fluoro-cyclized amine with chlorophenyl). Good.

Now need to apply template 1914394 to each of those fragments? The order is fixed: 1914393 then 1914394 then 1914395. Likely we apply 1914394 to one of the fragments from previous step, then 1914395 to resulting fragments.

We attempted apply 1914394 to fragment A (COc1cccc(NC(=O)c2nn[nH]c2N)c1) but got no result. Maybe apply to fragment B? Let's try.
